title: babel sessions
description: One panel over the baseline's doors: pick an online machine and one of babel's read-only reports, record the run through atyrode.babel.run, and open a terminal tile on that machine running it. Browsing archived sessions waits on a hub-reachable babel API; babel web binds loopback only.

atyrode.babel.reason: The panel records every run through atyrode.babel.run and reads atyrode.babel.listRuns.
